No, Leafy Plus does not include free Express shipping. Express is $14.95 and is never free, including for Leafy Plus members.

What Leafy Plus ($59/year) does include for shipping is free Standard shipping with no minimum order. Without membership, Standard is $7.95 and is free on orders of $75 or more.

Express delivery times depend on your zone: next business day in Zone 1 (under 300 miles from the nearest greenhouse) and 2 business days in Zone 2 (300-1,000 miles). Express isn't available in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, plus remote and island addresses). XL plants ship Standard only.
